description: German property listings from immowelt.de for a city: per listing the property type, city, price in EUR, rooms, living area (m²), floor when given and listing URL (first page, ~30 listings), plus the market summary immowelt publishes for the search: number of offers and lowest/highest price. Apartments or houses, to buy or rent. Related tools on this server, for a different need: realestate_landwatch when you need LandWatch land, ranch, farm and hunting property listings; realestate_loopnet when you need LoopNet commercial real estate listings for a US city. Price: $0.002 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.

city.description: German city as in immowelt URLs, e.g. berlin, muenchen, hamburg (required)
